verdict.rationale: Bolt is operated mainly through natural-language prompts. The docs cover starting projects from a blank prompt, prompting and editing in multiplayer, and a chat-based Plan Mode. The GitHub repo says the AI controls the full environment and can deploy to production from chat. A hands-on user reports making 99% of edits through prompts. Community reports of doom loops are about reliability, not whether the capability exists, so they lower confidence rather than the verdict. Missing for 10: evidence that account-level operations (billing, domains, sharing settings) can also be driven by natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Bolt.new gives AI models complete control over the entire environment including the filesystem, node server, package manager, terminal, and browser console.
Anyone can start from a blank prompt, upload files to build with, or import designs from Figma or Google Stitch.
Bolt has a chat mode called Plan Mode where you can plan and ask questions without making changes to your code.
both were built in bolt with 99% of edits made through prompts
